title: Widget definition for display_widget dynamic mode
description: The declarative renderer envelope an agent authors and passes to the display_widget tool in dynamic mode. The server echoes it to the native Mosaic renderer, which reads renderer.componentOverrides.$ : a tile/widget root whose children are the tile blocks rendered top to bottom. Author fully-hydrated literals; there is no expression compilation on this path. This schema documents the recommended full-envelope form (the server also accepts shorthands: a bare mosaic root, a plain array of blocks, or a single block).

renderer.description: The renderer envelope. Supply componentOverrides.$ (a tile/widget root); body is an accepted alternative slot for a tile tree.

componentOverrides.description: Holds the render root under the $ key.

body.description: Alternative slot for the render root.

mosaicRoot.description: The tile/widget root. Its children are the top-level tile blocks, rendered in order.

type.description: Root type discriminator. Set to mosaic.

definition.description: Root definition. Set to tile/widget. tile/mosaic is the legacy spelling, still accepted (the server emits it when normalizing the shorthand input forms).

children.description: The tile blocks to render, top to bottom.

block.description: One tile block: a definition naming the tile, an attributes object of block-specific props, and (for layout/container blocks) children. tile/table is the exception: its data lives in attributes.columns and attributes.rows, not in children.

definition.description: Which tile to render, e.g. tile/text. See the per-definition attribute rules under allOf.

type.description: Optional type discriminator; usually omitted for non-root blocks.

attributes.description: Block-specific properties. Use each block's real attribute name (tile/text uses text, tile/badge uses label, tile/markdown uses source). Extra attributes a host understands are allowed.

children.description: Nested blocks, for layout/container blocks (tile/container, tile/row, tile/column, tile/list, tile/listItem, tile/accordion, tile/tabSet, tile/tab).

buttonAttributes.description: Attributes for a tile/button block: a real, clickable call to action. Every button must carry an actions.click action; there are no decorative buttons.

label.description: The button text. Required. Write the resolved action label (e.g. "Draft the plan", "View in Salesforce").

variant.description: Button style. Defaults to secondary. Use primary for the single lead action in a callout; secondary for supporting actions.

iconName.description: Optional icon name shown before the label (e.g. send, link).

actions.description: The actions fired by the button, keyed by event. Required. Currently only the click event is supported; its value is a non-empty array of actions run in order when the button is clicked.

click.description: Actions fired on click, in order. Each is either a sendMessage (post a chat message back to the agent) or an openLink (navigate to a URL in a new tab).

buttonAction.description: A tile/button click action. Discriminated by definition: action/sendMessage posts a chat message back to the agent; action/openLink opens a URL. Author fully-resolved literals in attributes (no {{token}} placeholders remain after hydration).

definition.description: Which action to fire. action/sendMessage sends attributes.content to the chat as the user (a draft/ask CTA). action/openLink navigates to attributes.url (a View-in-Salesforce / Open-in-CRM CTA).

attributes.description: Action payload. For action/sendMessage, supply content. For action/openLink, supply url (and optionally target).

content.description: The message text sent to the chat as the user when the button is clicked. Required. Write it as a first-person request the rep sends back to the agent (e.g. "Draft a next step for the Acme renewal"). The host inserts it into the composer; whether it auto-sends is host-controlled.

url.description: The URL to open in a new tab when the button is clicked. Required. For a Salesforce record, build the Lightning URL https://<myDomain>/lightning/r/<SObjectType>/<Id>/view (never a REST API path). Allowed schemes: http, https, mailto, tel — other schemes are rejected. Omit the button entirely if you lack the record Id.

target.description: Where to open the link. Defaults to _blank (new tab).

iconName.description: An icon name drawn by the renderer. The full set of icons the shipped renderer can draw (Lucide glyphs plus Salesforce aliases). A name outside this set renders nothing.

iconAttributes.description: Attributes for a tile/icon block: a single glyph. Set alt to a short description, or "" when the icon is decorative and the adjacent text already carries the meaning.

size.description: Icon size, as a size token (xs, sm, md, lg, xl) or a CSS length. Defaults to md.

alt.description: Accessible label. Use "" for a decorative icon whose meaning is already in the adjacent text.

key.description: Property name looked up in each row object. Required.

align.description: Cell alignment. Defaults to left; use right for numeric columns.

textAttributes.description: Attributes for a tile/text block: a single run of styled text.

text.description: The literal, fully-resolved text to display. Required. Write the final string here; Mosaic {!...} expressions are not compiled on this path and are stripped.

variant.description: Typographic role. Defaults to body. h1-h6 are headings; caption is small/secondary; code is monospace. Editorial variants: page-title (large serif title, renders as h1), section-title (serif section heading, renders as h2), eyebrow (small uppercase label above a title), display (oversized serif stat number for KPI values).

color.description: Semantic text color. Defaults to default.

isItalic.description: Render the text italic. Defaults to false.

isStrikethrough.description: Strike through the text. Defaults to false.

markdownAttributes.description: Attributes for a tile/markdown block: a formatted markdown string. Use for multi-paragraph or richly formatted prose.

source.description: The markdown source string to render. Required.

badgeAttributes.description: Attributes for a tile/badge block: a small status pill.

label.description: The pill text. Required. Note this is label, not text.

variant.description: Pill style. Defaults to primary. Use success/warning/error/info to convey status.

linkAttributes.description: Attributes for a tile/link block: a hyperlink.

text.description: Visible link text. Falls back to the href when omitted.

underline.description: When to underline the link. Defaults to hover.

calloutAttributes.description: Attributes for a tile/callout block: a boxed notice with a title and optional body.

eyebrow.description: Optional small uppercase kicker shown above the title (e.g. "RECOMMENDED MOVE", "THE PLAY"). Use to name the callout's role.

description.description: Optional body text under the title.

variant.description: Notice style. Defaults to default. Editorial variants: recommended (blue, star icon — the lead synthesis/next-move callout, place first and give it a button); blocker (red-bordered, alert-triangle icon — a critical blocker).

iconName.description: Optional icon name shown next to the title, overriding the variant's default icon (e.g. star, alert-triangle).

separatorAttributes.description: Attributes for a tile/separator block: a divider rule.

containerAttributes.description: Attributes for a tile/container block: a panel with a rounded border. Put content blocks in children. Takes no width/padding of its own — to make a container fill or share a wrapped row, wrap it in a tile/column carrying width (and, for reflow control, minWidth).

borderless.description: Omit the container's rounded border. Defaults to false.

variant.description: Container surface style. "default" matches the background; "emphasis" is a subtle neutral shade; the semantic variants (info/warning/error/success) tint the fill and border. Defaults to default.

columnAttributes.description: Attributes for a tile/column block: a vertical stack of its children.

gap.description: Space between children. Defaults to md.

align.description: Cross-axis (horizontal) alignment of children, e.g. start, center, end, stretch.

width.description: Column width, as a size token or a CSS length.

rowAttributes.description: Attributes for a tile/row block: a horizontal layout of its children.

gap.description: Space between children. Defaults to md.

align.description: Cross-axis (vertical) alignment of children, e.g. start, center, end, stretch.

isWrapped.description: Allow children to wrap onto multiple lines. Defaults to false.

listAttributes.description: Attributes for a tile/list block. Its children are tile/listItem blocks.

marker.description: List marker style. Defaults to bullet.

tableAttributes.description: Attributes for a tile/table block. columns, rows, and caption are all required. Table data lives here in attributes, not in children.

columns.description: Ordered column definitions. Required. Column order is display order.

rows.description: Row data. Required. Each row is an object whose keys match column keys; every cell VALUE is a string, so format numbers and dates into display-ready strings yourself (for example a currency string or an ISO date). A missing key renders as an empty cell.

isStickyHeader.description: Keep the header row visible while scrolling. Defaults to false.

valueFormat4.description: Value display format. number (default), percent, currency, or compact (e.g. 1.2M).

valueFormat3.description: Value display format. number (default), percent, or currency.

chartAttributes.description: Attributes for a tile/chart block: a multi-point, multi-series bar/line/area/column chart. Author numeric data as numbers (not strings). Every series is named and values can be labelled on the marks so the read never depends on color.

chartType.description: Chart geometry. Required. bar is horizontal, column vertical.

series.description: One or more data series. Required.

name.description: Series label (shown in the legend). Required.

data.description: Data points aligned to categories. Required. Use null for a gap.

type.description: Overrides chartType for this series (combo charts).

caption.description: Accessible description / summary of the chart. Required.

stackMode.description: How series stack. Defaults to none. normalized stacks to 100%.

showValues.description: Label the value on each mark. Defaults to false.

showLegend.description: Show the series legend. Defaults to true.

sparklineAttributes.description: Attributes for a tile/sparkline block: a compact inline trend for a single KPI. Data are numbers.

data.description: The trend data points. Required. Use null for a gap.

baseline.description: A reference-line value drawn across the sparkline.

showEndpoint.description: Mark and label the last point. Defaults to true.

highlightExtremes.description: Mark and label the min and max points. Defaults to false.

meterAttributes.description: Attributes for a tile/meter block: a bounded bullet graph for goal/attainment. value is a number; valueLabel is the formatted read shown to the user.

valueLabel.description: The formatted value label (e.g. '$1.3M — 130% of target'). Required.

target.description: Target tick position on the scale.

bands.description: Qualitative ranges drawn behind the value bar.

overAttainment.description: Show a marker when value exceeds max. Defaults to true.

showValue.description: Show the value label. Defaults to true.

piechartAttributes.description: Attributes for a tile/piechart block: a part-to-whole pie or donut. Slice values are numbers; every slice prints its share on the wedge and in the legend.

role.description: Emphasis. highlight draws a thicker stroke. Defaults to normal.

showValues.description: Print the percentage on each wedge. Defaults to true.

showLegend.description: Show the legend with value and percentage. Defaults to true.

maxSlices.description: Bucket slices beyond this count into a single 'Other'.

waterfallAttributes.description: Attributes for a tile/waterfall block: a running-total bridge from a start value through signed steps to an end. Each step is signed so increase/decrease reads without color.

steps.description: The signed steps, applied in order. Required.

role.description: Direction. Defaults to auto (inferred from the sign of delta).

end.description: The ending bar. Required. Omit value to have it computed from start + steps.

value.description: End value. Computed from start + steps when omitted.

showConnectors.description: Draw connector lines between bars. Defaults to true.

showValues.description: Label the value on each bar. Defaults to true.

heatmapAttributes.description: Attributes for a tile/heatmap block: a matrix or calendar of a single measure. Provide cells (+ xLabels/yLabels) for matrix layout, or days for calendar layout. Every cell prints its value so the read never rests on color.

domain.description: Value range [min, max] the color/size scale maps. Required.

cells.description: Matrix cells. x and y match an xLabel/yLabel.

x.description: X coordinate; matches an xLabel. Required.

y.description: Y coordinate; matches a yLabel. Required.

valueLabel.description: Custom display label for the cell.

encode.description: Visual encoding of magnitude. Defaults to color.

scale.description: Color scale type. Defaults to sequential.

midpoint.description: Neutral midpoint (diverging scale only). Defaults to the domain center.

datagridAttributes.description: Attributes for a tile/datagrid block: a typed, sortable table with per-row status. Unlike tile/table (all-string cells), datagrid cells carry the raw typed value and the column type formats them.

key.description: Column key; matches a property in each row. Required.

type.description: How to render/format the cell. Defaults to text.

sortable.description: Allow sorting by this column. Defaults to true.

priority.description: Responsive visibility priority (higher = kept longer as width shrinks).

target.description: Target value for a databar-type column.

rows.description: Row records. Required. Each row maps column keys to a raw typed value (number for currency/percent, ISO string for date, number[] for sparkline) OR a cell object; plus optional _status and _tone to tint the whole row.

_status.description: Status label for the row (shown as a status chip).

display.description: Custom display text overriding the formatted value.

badgeVariant.description: Badge color (badge cell type). Status colors (success/warning/error/info) plus the neutral/primary/secondary/outline pill styles shared with the standalone tile/badge.

key.description: Column key to sort by. Required.

footer.description: Footer cells (e.g. totals), keyed to columns.

key.description: Column key this footer cell sits under. Required.

totalRows.description: Total row count, for a pagination/summary line.

emptyText.description: Message shown when rows is empty.

isStickyHeader.description: Keep the header row visible while scrolling. Defaults to false.

scatterAttributes.description: Attributes for a tile/scatter block: labeled (x, y) points on two continuous axes, with an optional third magnitude driving bubble size and an optional quadrant crosshair. Use for a two-variable relationship or portfolio map; author x/y/size as numbers. Every point is labeled so the read never depends on color or position.

points.description: The plotted points. Required, at least one.

label.description: Point name, e.g. an account or rep. Required.

x.description: Value on the x axis, in the axis' own units. Required.

y.description: Value on the y axis, in the axis' own units. Required.

size.description: Optional third magnitude; drives bubble AREA.

caption.description: Accessible description / summary of the plot. Required.

splitX.description: X of a quadrant crosshair; pair with splitY to split the plane into four named quadrants.

splitY.description: Y of a quadrant crosshair; pair with splitX.

quadrants.description: Names for the four corners when a splitX/splitY crosshair is drawn.

showLabels.description: Print point labels on the plot. Defaults to true.

timelineAttributes.description: Attributes for a tile/timeline block: dated rows on a calendar axis (a Gantt). Each item spans start->end ISO dates; a today line auto-flags past-due bars. Use for dated intervals, not a value over a category.

items.description: The dated rows. Required, at least one.

start.description: Bar start, ISO date YYYY-MM-DD. Required.

end.description: Bar end, ISO date YYYY-MM-DD. Required.

subCaption.description: Secondary caption naming the bars' encoding.

today.description: ISO date drawing the dashed now-line; bars ending before it are flagged past-due.

rangeStart.description: ISO date pinning the left edge of the axis. Pair with rangeEnd for a fixed window.

rangeEnd.description: ISO date pinning the right edge of the axis.

labelWidth.description: Width of the left label gutter, in px.

showDates.description: Print end dates on the bars. Defaults to true.

pastDueNote.description: Overrides the auto past-due footer rollup.

rangebandAttributes.description: Attributes for a tile/rangeband block: a shaded low->high band over ordered steps with an optional central line (a fan chart). Use for a range over an ordered axis, not a single value per category.

points.description: The ordered band points. Required, at least one.

mid.description: Optional central call drawn as a line.

lowLabel.description: Names the band's lower edge. Defaults to 'worst'.

midLabel.description: Names the central line. Defaults to 'commit'.

highLabel.description: Names the band's upper edge. Defaults to 'best'.

showEndLabels.description: Print the landing spread at the right edge. Defaults to true.
